Failed to fetch uploaded image from command output.

Allow upload images automatically based on YAML settings

Failed to get installed version of PicGo-Core (command line)

obligations.note: DELIBERATE DEVIATION (security): the command is tokenized to argv and run without a shell (Typora runs bash -c with only backslash and double quote escaped, so $() or backticks in file names execute); success also needs exit status 0.
